title: Thrusty Missile Model
description: Canonical, version-stamped interchange format for a Thrusty missile/launch-vehicle model. One file = one model. A thin adapter converts the flat `stages` array into the recursive stage2 chain that missile_from_dict() consumes. Unknown keys are permitted so the format can carry provenance and future fields without breaking older loaders.

schema_version.description: Bumped on any breaking change to this schema. The loader refuses files whose major version it does not understand.

missile_class.description: Classifies the BOOST/DELIVERY vehicle only; selects estimator fallback defaults (typical Isp, mass fraction, default guidance) when source data is missing, and has no effect when those fields are supplied. A hypersonic glide body is NOT a class here — it is modelled on the RV side as rv_kind='glider' riding on a booster of the appropriate ballistic class. Cruise is out of scope. See docs/ingestion/estimators.md.

country.description: Originating country/operator (ISO name). Optional, used for catalog filtering.

source.description: Where the numbers came from. Required for catalog inclusion so community values are auditable.

license.description: License for redistribution in the catalog, e.g. 'CC-BY-4.0'.

completeness.description: Computed by the resolver: weighted fraction of fields that are `given` or `derived` (vs `estimated`/`default`). Mirrored into catalog.json. Authors leave this out; the pipeline writes it.

provenance.description: Per-field record of how each value was obtained. Key = dotted field path (e.g. 'stages.0.isp_s'). Never read by the simulation; consumed by the report/UI to surface VERIFY flags.

source.description: Which rung of the resolution ladder produced this value.

unit_in.description: Original source unit before SI normalization, e.g. 'lbf', 'ft', 'nmi'.

stages.description: Powered stages, bottom (stage 1) first. Adapter links them into the stage2 chain. Top-level payload/RV/booster/shroud blocks attach to stage 1.

stage.description: One powered stage. Six fields are REQUIRED with no fallback; thrust_N and mass_final are derived when omitted.

name.description: Optional per-stage label; defaults to '<name> S<n>'.

mass_initial.description: kg — launch mass of this stage stack (structure + propellant + everything above).

mass_propellant.description: kg — usable propellant burned by this stage.

mass_final.description: kg — jettisoned dry hardware mass (debris/staging). DERIVED as mass_initial − mass_propellant when omitted.

length_m.description: m — body length. Derivable from L/D ratio × diameter.

isp_s.description: s — vacuum specific impulse. ESTIMATED from propellant/class when omitted (flagged VERIFY).

thrust_N.description: N — vacuum thrust. NOTE: Thrusty always re-derives thrust from Isp×g0×prop/burn; this field is reference/cross-check only.

nozzle_exit_area_m2.description: m² — for pressure-thrust altitude correction. 0 = legacy 2% back-pressure approximation.

coast_time_s.description: s — coast between this stage's burnout and next ignition. Ignored on last stage.

propellant_type.description: Selects the estimator row for Isp/mass-fraction when those are missing. Not consumed by physics directly.

solid_motor.description: True = cannot throttle/cut off; orbital insertion runs to natural burnout.

thrust_peak_N.description: N — peak vacuum thrust for solids; 0 = derive from average × fill factor.

burnout_angle_deg.description: deg — final elevation (pitch_program) or kick elevation (gravity_turn).

mach_table.description: Cd-vs-Mach lookup Mach axis. Empty = Forden (2007) defaults.

boosters.description: Strap-on boosters fired in parallel with stage 1. Omit entirely (or n=0) for none.

core_delay_s.description: s — delay before core ignition. 0 = simultaneous (Soyuz).

shroud.description: Payload fairing jettisoned during ascent. Omit (or mass=0) for none.

payload.description: What the vehicle delivers. `terminal_mode` is the discriminator that switches required fields, which estimators run, and which sanity checks apply (see estimators.md §8-9).

terminal_mode.description: reentry → requires an rv/rv_ref, runs the β/heating estimators, impact-side validation. orbital → a satellite that does NOT reenter: NO rv, NO β/heating (their absence is correct, not a gap); requires payload_kg + final-stage orbital_insertion; orbital-side validation (reaches orbital velocity, perigee, decay lifetime). suborbital_payload → mass to apogee, no orbit claimed. Default: 'orbital' when missile_class='slv', else 'reentry'.

payload_kg.description: kg — total to burnout. For orbital: the satellite mass to orbit.

rv_separates.description: True = empty last stage follows a separate debris arc.

rv_ref.description: reentry mode: name of an entry in the shared rv_library to attach instead of an inline rv block.

target_orbit_alt_km.description: orbital mode: target circular orbit altitude for orbital_insertion guidance. Omit to report the naturally achieved orbit.

rv.description: Inline reentry-vehicle definition (mirrors RVParams / rv_from_dict). Alternatively reference one via payload.rv_ref.

beta_kg_m2.description: kg/m² — ballistic coefficient m/(Cd·A). Derivable from mass/shape/diameter.

nose_radius_m.description: m — stagnation radius for Sutton-Graves heating; default 0.05.
